client.name: Harbourline Analytics (fictional)
client.brandContext: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. Harbourline Analytics is an invented company used only to exercise this software. It is described as a small software firm that helps mid-sized logistics operators keep their operational data trustworthy. Its voice is practical and plain-spoken, written by people who have run warehouses.
productsOrServices: Data quality monitoring for warehouse and transport systems
Automated reconciliation checks between inventory and order records

audience.icp: Operations leaders at mid-sized logistics and distribution companies who are accountable for weekly performance reporting and do not have a dedicated data team.
painPoints: Inventory figures in weekly reports that nobody trusts
Hours spent on manual reconciliation between systems
Decisions delayed because numbers have to be checked by hand

objectives: Establish a clear point of view on data quality as an operations problem rather than an IT problem
Prompt operations leaders to start a conversation about their own reporting

tone.voice: Practical, plain-spoken and specific. Sounds like an experienced operations person, not a marketer.
do: Use concrete warehouse and reporting situations

references.title: Synthetic pilot benchmark (invented for testing)
references.summary: INVENTED FIGURE FOR TESTING. In a pilot across 14 warehouses, teams using automated data checks cut the time spent on manual reconciliation by 31%.

references.title: Synthetic operations survey (invented for testing)
references.summary: INVENTED FIGURE FOR TESTING. In a survey of 120 operations leaders, 62% said they did not fully trust the inventory figures in their weekly report.

references.title: Product description (invented for testing)
references.summary: The product runs scheduled checks that compare inventory records with order and shipment records and flags mismatches for a person to review. It does not change any records itself.

constraints.evidencePolicy: Any figure, result or comparison must cite one of the references above. No customer names or quotations.
